g.title: G01: explicit design-schematic function guess to MYJG-80R laser PSU low-voltage control terminals position H (H · active-high switch-light control). FUNCTION GUESS ONLY, not a direct cable or a fitted conductor. Basis: GUESS: the config assigns a digital M3/M5 laser-fire output without an inversion marker, while the MYJG-80R manual describes H as the active-high switching input. This is only a semantic polarity match; no voltage threshold, electrical buffer, cable or endpoint mapping is documented. Interface: Possible active-high fire-control function through an unidentified interface. Do not infer voltage compatibility or a direct connection; L is left OPEN because it is active-low. Checks: Verify the installed Smoothieware output polarity at P1.23 and exact MYJG-80R H input threshold from authoritative revision-matched documents.; Trace any relay, buffer, isolation and cable between controller output and PSU input; confirm idle/fault state and interlocks independently.; Test only with laser high voltage disabled until a qualified interface and safety chain are documented.

G02: explicit design-schematic function guess to MYJG-80R laser PSU low-voltage control terminals position G (G · signal ground). FUNCTION GUESS ONLY, not a direct cable or a fitted conductor. Basis: GUESS: SmoothieBox PWM bank exposes a ground contact and MYJG80R names G as signal ground; no cable or common-reference scheme is documented. Interface: Candidate signal reference only; isolation and ground topology unverified. Checks: Trace both endpoint grounds and any galvanic isolation.; Measure potential difference and verify protective-earth/signal-ground separation before connection.

G03: explicit design-schematic function guess to MYJG-80R laser PSU low-voltage control terminals position IN (IN · laser power control input). FUNCTION GUESS ONLY, not a direct cable or a fitted conductor. Basis: GUESS: machine config enables laser PWM; MYJG80R labels IN as laser power control. London Hackspace says a level shifter was added, but its circuit and harness are undocumented. Interface: Use only as a functional hypothesis through an unspecified 5 V level-shift interface; voltage range, polarity, isolation and wiring remain unverified. Checks: Identify the exact installed PSU and verify its control terminal names and ratings against its manufacturer manual.; Trace and document the actual level-shifter board, grounds, polarity and both cable ends.; Measure controller PWM voltage, frequency and idle state with laser high voltage disabled.

svg.text: DOTTED VIOLET = FUNCTION GUESS ONLY. Paths start at the actual drawn exterior screw and end at the named machine contact. No installed continuity or direct cable is established.

OPEN / hollow contact = no SmoothieBox route selected in this study. This does not mean an electrically open circuit, unused pin or NC in the source. Source-empty, unlisted and untranscribed roles remain distinct in their labels.

REFERENCE ONLY = a named source revision, not the installed machine. Reference contacts stay OPEN unless an individually cited dotted function guess is shown. Named hardware with no contact map has an OPEN boundary, not invented '?'

Paths may cross without joining; pale crossing clearance means NO JUNCTION. Multiple guesses from one screw are alternatives unless each shares an explicit FAN-OUT tag. A tagged fan-out still needs separate buffers and load
validation. No return bus is inferred.

Exterior label colors: black = circuit GND; red = 3.3 V; orange = 5 V; yellow/gold = load/control feed; blue/violet/green = STEP/DIR/ENABLE. Dotted violet is an evidence state, not a reported cable color. Protective earth is not

DB25, DB44 and 15-contact D-sub housings are outside SmoothieBox. Contact strips preserve source order, not physical pin-row geometry. USB device, USB host, Ethernet and microSD are separate service ports.
RESEARCH DIAGRAM — NOT QUALIFIED FOR PHYSICAL WIRING. Confirm the actual carrier, machine revision, mating view, electrical interface, protection, returns and safety design before construction.
